item.title: Shredders – the physical edition for PlayStation 5 is out now! | Microids
item.description: Microids and I-Illusions are delighted to announce the release today of the physical PlayStation 5 edition of the snowboarding game Shredders. This must-have title will delight snow sports enthusiasts, thrill-seekers, and collectors alike.

item.title: Rooftops & Alleys is now available in the physical Dual Pack Edition on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox Series! | Microids
item.description: Rooftops & Alleys, the parkour game phenomenon praised by thousands of overwhelmingly positive reviews, is available now on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series and Nintendo Switch in a special physical edition created by Microids.

item.title: Syberia VR is now available! | Microids
item.description: Microids is thrilled to announce the release of Syberia VR and to unveil the game’s launch trailer. The title is now available on Meta Quest 3.

item.title: Agatha Christie – Death on the Nile Shines in Its Accolade Trailer | Microids
item.description: Les médias donnent leur avis sur la nouvelle enquête du célèbre détective !

item.title: Syberia Remastered: Discover the New Accolades Trailer | Microids
item.description: Microids is delighted to showcase the newly released Accolades Trailer for Syberia Remastered, highlighting the game’s warm reception since launch.

item.title: The iconic board game King of Tokyo is coming to video game platforms in 2026 | Microids
item.description: The legendary board game King of Tokyo, created by renowned game designer Richard Garfield, the mastermind behind the iconic Magic: The Gathering, is making its video game debut in Spring 2026.

item.description: Corsairs – Battle of the Caribbean will set sail on May 18, 2026, in a completely reimagined new edition!
